description:
“Whenever you want” makes it sound trivial, which it isn’t.

But that’s what it comes down to; what do you want to be doing right now? Scrolling endlessly?

Or getting shit done? I know you don’t feel like it. I know it’s overwhelming. But so is doing nothing.

If you have to choose between two painful options, choose the one that feeds your soul.

Whenever you can, do what feeds your soul.

transcript: You're avoiding something right now, aren't you? But I'm assuming you already feel shit about it, so I just wanted to remind you that sometimes little things are fucking hard. Give yourself some credit. You're doing better than you think. So if there's a voice in your head trying to convince you that you're stuck, I'd like to disagree with it. It's wrong. You can get it done, whenever you like. When you don't believe in you, the rest of us will believe for you. I'm going this way, but give me a shout if you need a hand. And come along if you want.
